description: A library with ready-made, themed components (MUI, Ant Design, Mantine, Chakra UI). Customized through a theme and props.
Unstyled components that implement behavior and accessibility (Radix, Base UI, React Aria, Headless UI, Ark UI).
A CLI and registry that copies component source into your repo. Built on Base UI (default) or Radix plus Tailwind.
Ways to render a primitive as your own element: Radix merges props into its child with `asChild`, Base UI accepts a `render` prop.
